# Data Studios

> > Data Studios (Exafin) provides AI and data analysis training for finance and business professionals, specializing in ChatGPT, Python, and modern financial workflows.

Data Studios offers practical courses and resources focused on applying artificial intelligence and data science tools to finance, accounting, and business operations. The platform emphasizes hands-on learning with technologies like ChatGPT, Python, and Google Colab.

## Key Topics

- ChatGPT
- Python
- Google Colab
- Financial Analysis
- Prompt Engineering
- AI Business Training
- Accounting Workflows
- Data Analysis
- PDF Management
- GDPR Compliance
- Exafin
- Video Courses
- Payhip

## Courses & Training

- [ChatGPT for Finance & Business course](https://www.datastudios.org/chatgpt-for-finance-business-course): ChatGPT course for finance & business with Python and Google Colab

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.datastudios.org/privacy-policy): GDPR-compliant privacy policy for Data Studios/Exafin
